items.text: AWS highlighted Lambda MicroVMs as disposable sandboxes for AI agents to execute generated code without exposing credentials.
items.text_zh: AWS 展示了将 Lambda MicroVM 用作一次性 AI 智能体沙箱，让生成代码在不暴露凭证的环境中执行。

items.text: MiniMax said its open-weight H3 Max model achieved a significant leaderboard milestone, highlighting continued progress in its video-generation ecosystem.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 表示，开放权重的 H3 Max 模型取得重要榜单成绩，显示其视频生成生态仍在持续进步。

items.text: Sony Music and Warner Music sued Anthropic, alleging unauthorized copying of copyrighted lyrics for AI training and generated responses.
items.text_zh: 索尼音乐和华纳音乐起诉 Anthropic，指控其未经授权复制受版权保护的歌词，用于 AI 训练和生成回答。

items.text: Hailuo demonstrated H3 Max generating continuously extendable anime, positioning longer narrative continuity as a practical use for AI video.
items.text_zh: 海螺展示了 H3 Max 持续延展动漫内容的能力，将更长的叙事连续性作为 AI 视频的一项实际用途。

items.text: Databricks published practical guidance for moving AI prototypes into production, covering implementation patterns and operational considerations.
items.text_zh: Databricks 发布了将 AI 原型投入生产的实用指南，涵盖实施模式和运行阶段需要考虑的问题。

items.text: Tripo previewed Smart Mesh P2.0 through a game-companion creation challenge offering $6,000 in total prizes.
items.text_zh: Tripo 通过游戏风格伙伴创作挑战预览 Smart Mesh P2.0，并提供总计六千美元奖金。

items.text: AI-generated video is increasingly replacing some actors and livestreamers in China’s entertainment workflows, according to an industry report.
items.text_zh: 一份行业报道显示，AI 生成视频正在中国娱乐制作流程中逐渐替代部分演员和直播人员。

items.text: HarmonyOS 7’s visual AI supports natural-language image retrieval and low-resolution image enhancement within real-world applications.
items.text_zh: HarmonyOS 7 的视觉 AI 已在实际应用中支持自然语言找图和低清图像增强。

items.text: An investigation found that differences across 734 software dependencies can materially degrade locally deployed AI models versus official implementations.
items.text_zh: 一项调查发现，734 个软件依赖包之间的差异可能导致本地部署的 AI 模型明显落后于官方实现。

items.text: A Claude-based research agent reportedly outperformed human researchers costing $150 per hour while operating at roughly $4 per hour.
items.text_zh: 据报道，一个基于 Claude 的研究智能体以约每小时四美元的成本，超过了时薪一百五十美元的人类研究员。

items.text: A newly open-sourced OCR tool reportedly converts PDF content into Markdown in 20 milliseconds, nearly 300 times faster than a comparison system.
items.text_zh: 一款新近开源的 OCR 工具据称能在二十毫秒内把 PDF 转成 Markdown，速度接近对比系统的三百倍。

items.text: Alibaba’s Qoder coding product targets non-programmers with natural-language software creation and agent-assisted development workflows.
items.text_zh: 阿里巴巴的 Qoder 编程产品面向非程序员，提供自然语言软件创建和智能体辅助开发流程。

items.text: Google’s WikiSkill gives AI agents persistent records of previous successes and failures to improve performance on future tasks.
items.text_zh: Google 的 WikiSkill 为 AI 智能体保存以往成功与失败的持久记录，以改善后续任务表现。

items.text: Intel’s 32GB Arc Pro B70 GPU is being positioned for local AI-comic production and other memory-intensive generative workloads.
items.text_zh: 英特尔配备三十二 GB 显存的锐炫 Pro B70 GPU 正被用于本地 AI 漫剧制作等高显存生成任务。

items.text: Huawei’s HarmonySpace summer update added an agent that proactively remembers navigation addresses mentioned during conversations.
items.text_zh: 华为 HarmonySpace 暑期更新加入导航智能体，可主动记住对话中提到的地址。

items.text: Researchers found current AI agents systematically misjudge elapsed time and remain unaware of their own timing errors.
items.text_zh: 研究人员发现，现有 AI 智能体会系统性误判时间流逝，且无法意识到自身的计时错误。

items.text: A study found that academic skills rewarded with top grades are also among those generative AI can imitate most convincingly.
items.text_zh: 一项研究发现，最容易获得高分的学术能力，也恰是生成式 AI 最能逼真模仿的能力。

items.text: Toshiba began selling 8TB and 10TB S300 AI hard drives designed for continuous video-surveillance workloads.
items.text_zh: 东芝开始销售 8TB 和 10TB 的 S300 AI 硬盘，面向持续运行的视频监控负载。

items.text: Honor’s humanoid robot Lightning competed in a Malaysian marathon, marking the robot’s first overseas public appearance.
items.text_zh: 荣耀人形机器人“闪电”参加马来西亚马拉松，完成首次海外公开亮相。

items.text: Hugging Face’s Microduck robot reportedly attracted more than $2.6 million in orders within its first 24 hours.
items.text_zh: 据报道，Hugging Face 的 Microduck 机器人在首个 24 小时内获得超过 260 万美元订单。

items.text: Anthropic’s revised Claude Code limits raise the stated allowance but can reduce practical usage for some subscribers.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 调整 Claude Code 用量限制后，名义额度有所提高，但部分订阅用户的实际可用量可能下降。

items.text: Together AI said GLM-5.3 Flash costs 17 times less, while full GLM-5.3 is more reliable on first attempts.
items.text_zh: Together AI 表示，GLM-5.3 Flash 成本低 17 倍，而完整版 GLM-5.3 首次尝试的可靠性更高。

items.text: MiniMax highlighted its collaboration with generative-media platform fal, emphasizing joint execution in bringing creative AI capabilities to market.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 强调了与生成式媒体平台 fal 的合作，突出双方共同推动创意 AI 能力落地。

items.text: Code-as-World uses an agentic loop to reconstruct real videos as executable MuJoCo physics programs rather than conventional pixel predictions.
items.text_zh: Code-as-World 通过智能体循环，将真实视频重建为可执行的 MuJoCo 物理程序，而非传统像素预测。
